description: Dry conditions: the bird flies across the first region.
caption: Meet Alice, a bird flying on dry wings.

description: The puddle represents wet feathers. CanFly is false, so the bird walks across this region.
caption: Alice stops for a fish. Her wings get wet in the puddle, so she walks.

description: Dry conditions are restored for this region. CanFly is true, and the bird takes off again.
caption: Her wings are dry again, and Alice takes flight.

description: Rain represents wet feathers. CanFly is false, so the bird lands and walks to the end.
caption: Heavy rain wets her wings again. Alice lands and walks.
